features.name: 13 pre-payment gates
features.description: Merchant permitted, intent valid, fields complete, cart unique, attributes/quantities/prices/currency match, items available, within cap, confirmation matches, authorization fresh, idempotency free.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: 9 post-payment gates
features.description: Payment captured, no refund, amount/currency match, single candidate, correlation, order repairable, not expired, no prior effect.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: TOCTOU-safe authorization freshness
features.description: A stale signed Authorization is rejected by G_AUTHORIZATION_FRESH even if every other check passes.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Decision Council (bounded multi-agent recommendation)
features.description: Filter -> Fit -> Critic -> code veto. Advisory only; never selects an offer or writes a cart. Falls back to a deterministic top-ranked survivor if the LLM proposes an ID that was never offered to it.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Signed Authorization (Ed25519)
features.description: Frozen, signed artifact issued once a cart passes every pre-payment gate; independently re-verifiable from its own bytes.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Idempotency ledger
features.description: UNIQUE-constraint-backed; one business effect however many times a call is retried.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: PAYMENT_UNKNOWN + webhook reconciliation
features.description: A lost payment response is marked UNKNOWN, never silently treated as failed or captured; resolved via receipt lookup or a real webhook delivery, HMAC-verified, deduplicated by x-razorpay-event-id.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Real Razorpay integration (test mode)
features.description: Order creation, checkout, constant-time signature verification, independent fetch.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Tamper-evident audit chain
features.description: Hash-chained (sha256(prev_hash || canonical_json(payload))); verify_chain recomputes every hash from stored content rather than trusting it. Refusals recorded with the same weight as actions.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Connector evidence/capability directory
features.description: Every known commerce surface, its evidence tier (direct/connector-verified, available-untested, restricted, unavailable) and capability (cart-mutable vs. discovery-only), independent of each other.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Connector backend-type classification
features.description: Distinguishes a real independently-reachable remote MCP endpoint from one that only exists inside Claude's own consumer app directory -- the exact conflation an external review caught.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Merchant reach resolution
features.description: Shoppable / blocked-by-policy / not-reachable / unknown, with the reason stated -- never silently defaults to a web search.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Real Shopify Storefront MCP integration
features.description: No key needed; live-verified against real stores' /api/mcp endpoints.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Swiggy Instamart/Food live proof (via a Claude session)

features.name: Fixed-fifty benchmark

features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Baseline comparison

features.name: Reason codes
features.description: OG-XXX-NNN structured codes for every gate refusal.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: OrderGuard as an MCP server
features.description: record_intent, check_cart, verify_audit_trail, recommend_connector, list_verified_connectors -- usable by any external assistant holding any connector's cart.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Dual agent runtime (API + subscription)
features.description: AnthropicApiRuntime (Messages API MCP Connector beta) and SubscriptionAgentRuntime (Claude Agent SDK) share one AgentTurnResult shape; verified directly against each runtime's current docs to differ in wire format on purpose, not by oversight. Subscription path live-verified 2026-08-31: a real mission through the browser UI resolved a real address, called the real Swiggy Instamart search_products tool, and returned 33 real offers. AnthropicApiRuntime remains offline-tested only -- no real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY has been exercised end-to-end.
features.evidence: Live-verified 2026-08-31: a real mission through the browser UI (subscription runtime) resolved a real saved address, called the real Swiggy Instamart search_products tool, and returned 33 real offers -- see docs/CONNECTORS.md.

features.name: R3 (financial) tool exclusion
features.description: A payment-capable tool can never enter either runtime's tool list -- enforced once, at the one function both adapters call, not per-runtime.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Universal ConnectorResult model
features.description: A Pydantic discriminated union (commerce/dev-task/calendar/email/task/file/unsupported); only commerce and dev-task are wired to a live connector -- the rest are real, typed, unfilled extension points, not fabricated pipelines.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Connector eligibility engine
features.description: Deterministic: category match, reachable backend type, not policy-restricted, account connected where required. The LLM only ever picks inside this pre-filtered set.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Universal action-approval lifecycle
features.description: R0 auto-executes, R1 needs opt-in, R2 needs explicit approval, R3 never enters this lifecycle at all -- structurally routed to the existing payment path instead.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Commerce Missions
features.description: Multi-intent decomposition; every intent independently risk-governed; only a financial sub-transaction is ever OrderGuard-authorized, never a merged global authorization.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Encrypted connector credential store
features.description: Fernet-encrypted bearer tokens, owner-scoped (LOCAL_SINGLE_USER today; not process-global by construction), shared by both runtimes.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Real Swiggy backend OAuth (Developer flow)
features.description: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, confirmed self-serve on localhost directly from Swiggy's own docs. Live-verified 2026-08-31: a real browser OAuth round trip completed against mcp.swiggy.com, the resulting token was encrypted and stored in ConnectorAccount, and the connector immediately showed CONNECTED with no further steps.
features.evidence: Live-verified 2026-08-31: a real browser OAuth round trip completed against mcp.swiggy.com; the token was encrypted, stored in ConnectorAccount, and the connector immediately showed CONNECTED.

features.name: GitHub connector (required non-commerce proof)
features.description: Chosen because it needs only a personal access token, not an OAuth app -- the fastest real path to a second, genuinely different connector.
features.evidence: Offline implementation only; current live credential proof is pending.

features.name: SSRF-hardened custom connectors
features.description: HTTPS-only, private/loopback/link-local IP rejection, cross-host redirect rejection, re-resolved on every call (not just at registration) to close the DNS-rebinding gap; discovered tools stored disabled until explicitly enabled with a non-R3 risk tier.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: BYOK Anthropic API key
features.description: In-memory only; never written to disk, logged, or echoed back beyond a masked confirmation. Distinct from the server-managed .env key and the subscription runtime.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.

features.name: Connector backend compatibility matrix
features.description: Every connector classified as REMOTE_MCP / NATIVE_API_ADAPTER / CUSTOM_MCP / CLAUDE_DIRECTORY_ONLY / BROWSER_HANDOFF / UNSUPPORTED before it can be labeled reachable.
features.evidence: Covered by the repository test suite; current clean live verification is not claimed.
